name: Hallowed Ground
description: You place a platinum idol on the ground and consecrate the area within a very short (5 unit) radius around it. Choose two conditions from the following: afraid, charmed, confused, maddened, ignited, blinded, or deafened. For the next hour, allies within the area are immune to the chosen conditions. Any ally currently suffering from a chosen condition is freed of it upon entering the area. All attacks and spells channeled against you or your allies within the area are rolled with a penalty die. The area is centered on the idol and does not move.
charge: The effect is permanent as long as the idol remains in place. If the idol is touched, moved, or destroyed, the effect ends immediately and the idol is destroyed.
